info.name: 🚀 Learning NestJS API
info.description:
# 🚀 Learning NestJS API Collection

Comprehensive API documentation and test suite for the **Learning NestJS** backend with **PostgreSQL** and **TypeORM**.

---

### ⚙️ Variables
* `baseUrl`: `http://localhost:3000/api`

### 📂 Modules
1. **📦 Products:** Full CRUD connected to PostgreSQL via TypeORM.
2. **👥 Users:** User management & authentication endpoints (with Pre-Registration OTP & Verification Tickets).
3. **⭐ Reviews:** Product review endpoints.
4. **🌐 System:** App health & welcome endpoint.

item.name: 📦 Products
item.description: Endpoints for managing products stored in PostgreSQL database via TypeORM.

item.name: 📦 Get All Plants (With Botanical Filters & Pagination)

query.description: Search title, description, scientific name, or category

request.description:
### 📦 Get All Products
Fetches paginated products with dynamic filtering and sorting.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/products`
* **Query Parameters:**
  * `search` (optional): Search in title or description (ILIKE)
  * `minPrice` / `maxPrice` (optional): Filter price range
  * `userId` (optional): Filter by creator UUID
  * `sortBy` (optional): `createdAt` | `price` | `title` (default: `createdAt`)
  * `sortOrder` (optional): `ASC` | `DESC` (default: `DESC`)
  * `page` (optional): Page number (default: `1`)
  * `limit` (optional): Items per page (default: `10`)
* **Success Response:** `200 OK` (returns `{ data, meta }`)

### 🔍 Get Product By ID
Fetches a single product by its unique integer identifier.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/products/:id`
* **Throws:** `404 Not Found` if product does not exist.

request.description:
### 🌱 Create Plant Product (Admin Only)
Creates a new plant with botanical details, care requirements, stock, and placement settings.

* **Method:** `POST`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/products`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Access:** Admin only (`@Roles(UserType.ADMIN)`)

### ✏️ Update Product (Admin Only)
Updates an existing product in the database. Restricted to Admins.

* **Method:** `PUT`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/products/:id`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Access:** Admin only (`@Roles(UserType.ADMIN)`)
* **Body:** All fields are optional (`title`, `description`, `price`).
* **Throws:**
  * `401 Unauthorized` if token is missing or invalid.
  * `403 Forbidden` if caller is not an Admin.
  * `404 Not Found` if product does not exist.

### 🗑️ Delete Product (Admin Only)
Permanently removes a product from PostgreSQL. Restricted to Admins.

* **Method:** `DELETE`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/products/:id`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Access:** Admin only (`@Roles(UserType.ADMIN)`)
* **Success Response:** `{"message": "Product deleted successfully"}`
* **Throws:**
  * `401 Unauthorized` if token is missing or invalid.
  * `403 Forbidden` if caller is not an Admin.
  * `404 Not Found` if product does not exist.

formdata.description: Image files (JPEG, JPG, PNG, WEBP, max 5MB each, max 5 images)

request.description:
### 🖼️ Upload Product Images (Admin Only - Cloudinary)
Uploads multiple product images concurrently directly to Cloudinary (`planto/products`) using streaming MemoryStorage without disk persistence.

* **Method:** `POST`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/products/:id/images`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Access:** Admin only (`@Roles(UserType.ADMIN)`)
* **Body:** `form-data` with key `images` (supports multiple files)
* **Storage:** Cloudinary Cloud Storage (`memoryStorage`)
* **Allowed Formats:** JPEG, JPG, PNG, WEBP
* **Max Size:** 5 MB per file, max 5 files per upload
* **Response:** `{ "message": "N image(s) uploaded successfully", "images": ["https://res.cloudinary.com/planto/...", ...] }`

### 🖼️ Get Product Image
Redirects (HTTP 302) to the matching product image hosted on Cloudinary.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/products/images/:filename`
* **Response:** `302 Found` redirecting to Cloudinary URL.

variable.description: Filename of the image to remove

request.description:
### 🗑️ Delete Product Image (Admin Only - Cloudinary)
Destroys the specified product image from Cloudinary asset storage and removes its URL from the product's images array.

* **Method:** `DELETE`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/products/:id/images/:filename`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Access:** Admin only (`@Roles(UserType.ADMIN)`)
* **Response:** `{ "message": "Product image deleted successfully", "images": [...] }`

item.name: 👥 Users & Auth
item.description: Endpoints for user authentication and management.

request.description:
### 📩 Send Verification Code (Pre-Registration Step 1)
Generates a 6-digit OTP code, saves it in Redis (TTL: 10 mins), and enqueues an email dispatch job via BullMQ.

* **Method:** `POST`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/send-verification-code`
* **Body:**
  * `email`: Valid email format (required)
* **Throws:** `400 Bad Request` if email is already registered.

### ✅ Verify OTP Code (Pre-Registration Step 2)
Validates the 6-digit OTP code against Redis, deletes the consumed OTP, and issues a single-use `verificationToken` valid for 15 minutes.

* **Method:** `POST`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/verify-code`
* **Body:**
  * `email`: Valid email format (required)
  * `code`: Exactly 6 digits (required)
* **Success Response:** `200 OK` returns `{ message, verificationToken }`
* **Postman Test Script:** Automatically captures `verificationToken` into variables for Step 3.

### 🔐 Register User (Pre-Registration Step 3)
Registers a new user account with hashed password using the verified single-use `verificationToken`. The server extracts the verified email directly from Redis, preventing email resubmission.

* **Method:** `POST`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/register`
* **Body Validation:**
  * `verificationToken`: Single-use token from Step 2 (required)
  * `username`: String (3 - 30 chars, required)
  * `password`: String (min 6 chars, required)
  * `confirmPassword`: Must match password (required)

### 🔑 Login User
Authenticates an existing user by email and password.

* **Method:** `POST`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/login`
* **Body Validation:**
  * `email`: Valid email format (required)
  * `password`: String (required)

### 🌐 Google OAuth 2.0 Login
Redirects the browser / user to Google's OAuth 2.0 Consent Screen with `openid profile email` scopes.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/google`
* **Response:** `302 Redirect` to `https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?...`

query.description: Error string if user declined consent

request.description:
### 🌐 Google OAuth 2.0 Callback
Google redirects the user here with a one-time authorization `code`. The backend exchanges the code for a Google token, loads user info, creates or links the account, emits registration events, signs a Planto JWT, and redirects to the frontend callback URL.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/google/callback?code=<code>`
* **Response:** `302 Redirect` to `${frontendUrl}/auth/callback?token=<jwt>`

### 👤 Get Current User Profile (Me)
Fetches the authenticated user's profile using the JWT token passed in the Authorization header.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/me`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Throws:** `401 Unauthorized` if token is missing, invalid, or expired.

### ✏️ Update Current User Profile (Me)
Updates the authenticated user's profile using their JWT token (no ID needed in URL).

* **Method:** `PUT`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/me`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Throws:** `401 Unauthorized` if token is missing or invalid.

item.name: 🗑️ Delete Current User Account (Me - Soft Delete)

request.description:
### 🗑️ Delete Current User Account (Me - Soft Delete)
Soft-deletes the caller's own account. The user has a **30-day grace period** to reactivate the account by logging back in.

* **Method:** `DELETE`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/me`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Throws:** `401 Unauthorized` if token is missing or invalid.

formdata.description: Image file (JPEG, JPG, PNG, WEBP, max 2MB)

request.description:
### 🖼️ Upload Profile Image (Cloudinary)
Uploads or replaces the authenticated user's profile image directly to Cloudinary (`planto/profiles`) using streaming MemoryStorage. No files are stored on disk. If an existing image exists on Cloudinary, it is automatically destroyed.

* **Method:** `POST`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/profile-image`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Body:** `form-data` with key `image` (file)
* **Storage:** Cloudinary Cloud Storage (`memoryStorage`)
* **Allowed Formats:** JPEG, JPG, PNG, WEBP
* **Max Size:** 2 MB
* **Response:** `{ "message": "Profile image set successfully", "profileImage": "https://res.cloudinary.com/planto/..." }`

### 🖼️ Get Profile Image
Redirects (HTTP 302) directly to the user's secure Cloudinary profile image URL or Google CDN avatar.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/profile-image`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Response:** `302 Found` redirecting to Cloudinary / Google CDN URL.

### 🗑️ Remove Profile Image (Cloudinary)
Deletes the user's profile image asset from Cloudinary and clears the profile image field in the database.

* **Method:** `DELETE`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/profile-image`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Response:** `{ "message": "Profile image removed successfully" }`

### 👥 Get All Users (Admin Only)
Retrieves a list of all registered users. Restricted to users with the `admin` role.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Access:** Admin only (`@Roles(UserType.ADMIN)`)
* **Throws:**
  * `401 Unauthorized` if token is missing or invalid.
  * `403 Forbidden` if authenticated user is not an Admin.

### 👤 Get User By ID
Retrieves profile details for a specific user.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/:id`

### ✏️ Update User By ID (Admin Only)
Updates another user's information. Restricted to Admins.

* **Method:** `PUT`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/:id`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Access:** Admin only (`@Roles(UserType.ADMIN)`)
* **Throws:**
  * `401 Unauthorized` if token is missing/invalid.
  * `403 Forbidden` if caller is not an Admin.

item.name: 🗑️ Delete / Ban User By ID (Admin Only)

request.description:
### 🗑️ Delete / Ban User By ID (Admin Only)
Suspends/bans a user by ID. The user will be blocked from logging in, and must appeal to an admin to restore their account.

* **Method:** `DELETE`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/:id`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Access:** Admin only (`@Roles(UserType.ADMIN)`)
* **Throws:**
  * `401 Unauthorized` if token is missing/invalid.
  * `403 Forbidden` if caller is not an Admin.

### 🔄 Restore User (Admin Only)
Restores a soft-deleted or admin-suspended user account.

* **Method:** `PATCH`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/auth/:id/restore`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Access:** Admin only (`@Roles(UserType.ADMIN)`)
* **Throws:**
  * `401 Unauthorized` if token is missing/invalid.
  * `403 Forbidden` if caller is not an Admin.
  * `404 Not Found` if user is not found or not deleted.

item.name: ⭐ Reviews
item.description: Endpoints for product ratings and feedback reviews.

query.description: Filter reviews for a specific product (UUID)
Filter reviews by a specific user (UUID)

request.description:
### ⭐ Get All Reviews
Fetches paginated reviews with dynamic filtering and sorting.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/reviews`
* **Query Parameters:**
  * `search` (optional): Search within comments (ILIKE)
  * `rating` (optional): Exact rating (1-5)
  * `minRating` / `maxRating` (optional): Rating range
  * `productId` (optional): Filter by product UUID
  * `userId` (optional): Filter by author UUID
  * `sortBy` (optional): `createdAt` | `rating` (default: `createdAt`)
  * `sortOrder` (optional): `ASC` | `DESC` (default: `DESC`)
  * `page` (optional): Page number (default: `1`)
  * `limit` (optional): Items per page (default: `10`)
* **Success Response:** `200 OK` (returns `{ data, meta }`)

### 🔎 Get Review By ID
Fetches a specific review by ID.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/reviews/:id`

### ✍️ Create Review
Adds a new customer review for a product. Authenticated user ID is automatically extracted from JWT token.

* **Method:** `POST`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/reviews`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Access:** Any authenticated user (`@UseGuards(AuthGuard)`)
* **Body Validation:**
  * `rating`: Number (1 to 5, required)
  * `comment`: String (3 - 300 chars, required)
  * `productId`: UUID (required)

### 📝 Update Review (Owner Only)
Modifies review content or rating. Only the review creator is authorized (Admins cannot modify another user's review; they can only delete it).

* **Method:** `PUT`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/reviews/:id`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Access:** Review Creator only (`@UseGuards(AuthGuard)`)
* **Throws:**
  * `401 Unauthorized` if not logged in.
  * `403 Forbidden` if caller is not the review creator.
  * `404 Not Found` if review does not exist.

### 🗑️ Delete Review (Owner or Admin Only)
Removes a review from the system. Only the review creator or an Admin is authorized.

* **Method:** `DELETE`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/reviews/:id`
* **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
* **Access:** Owner or Admin (`@UseGuards(AuthGuard)`)
* **Throws:**
  * `401 Unauthorized` if not logged in.
  * `403 Forbidden` if caller is neither the owner nor an Admin.
  * `404 Not Found` if review does not exist.
